about_the_game:
Pathfinder 2 RPG - Troubles In Otari - Syrinscape Sound Link Pack


Syrinscape Sound Link Packs for Fantasy Grounds work with your Syrinscape Super Syrin subscription to provide you with context-specific sounds for monsters and NPCs in the Troubles In Otari adventure (not included).  The collection of Sound Sets can be created for free within the Fantasy Grounds Unity sound interface, but this pack has done all the work for you to link the monsters and story elements as you play the adventure. Appropriate sounds from Syrinscape will show up automatically in your Sound Context Window when you access a reference manual page or open an NPC.
This pack includes sound sets separated into the following categories for the Troubles In Otari adventure module (not included):
  • Important NPCs
  • Moods
  • Music
  • Elements
  • SFX
  • One-shots
These sound sets contain links to Syrinscape sounds only, and this pack does not grant you access to any sounds you don't already own at . For the best experience, we recommend subscribing to the Super Syrin or the Dungeons & Dragons subscription at Syrinscape to enable access to all sounds used in this sound link module. "
